guidance.bestFor: A text only first project prompt with Create and Import buttons side by side and a muted Learn more link below
agentNotes: Create project and Learn more render anchors with a hash `href`, and the Import project `Button` has no handler

whenNotToUse.when: A search that came back with no matches and offers a retry

guidance.bestFor: A no results message on a muted fill with no icon, a Try again button and a Learn more link with an arrow
agentNotes: The Try again `Button` has no handler; rerun the failed query from it

whenNotToUse.when: A missing page where the reader can type a new search right away

guidance.bestFor: A 404 page in a dashed outline holding a search field with a slash shortcut hint and a Contact support link
agentNotes: `InputGroupInput` is uncontrolled and nothing reads it, so the search field queries nothing until you wire it
The `Kbd` slash is a hint only; no key listener focuses the field when the key is pressed

guidance.bestFor: A folder tile over copy that links to the first post, in a dashed outline with an outline New Post button
A Recent Documents Card whose body holds a file tile and a small solid Create Document button

whenNotToUse.when: A prompt standing on the page with no titled card around it

guidance.bestFor: A dashed drop area of capped width with a cloud tile, a Browse Files button and an accepted types and size hint
agentNotes: The copy promises drag and drop, but nothing handles a drop and the Browse Files `Button` opens no file picker

whenNotToUse.when: A working drop zone that reads dragged items, checks type and size and lists them

guidance.bestFor: An inbox zero notice with an inbox tile and no button, for a message list that has been cleared
A Team Members Card that asks for the first collaborators through a small Invite People button with a user plus glyph
A muted filled panel with a crossed out bell and no action, waiting for the first alert to arrive

whenNotToUse.when: A no data panel that also offers buttons to connect a source or read docs

guidance.bestFor: An analytics placeholder in a dashed outline with a bar chart tile and Connect Data Source and View Docs buttons

whenNotToUse.when: A quiet notice with nothing to connect and no buttons at all

guidance.bestFor: A saved items list before the first bookmark, with a bookmark tile and one outline Browse Items button
A Tasks Card showing an all clear check tile and an outline New Task button once every to-do is done
